title: Images can become dubbed video
summary:
A model-heavy day: image-to-video with optional dubbing, a larger Klein, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and a monitor that knows a bad request is not a broken model.

Wan 2.6 was added as `wan` for image-to-video generation. It produces 720p clips lasting 2–15 seconds, with auto-dubbed audio on by default and an option to turn it off. Usage reporting separates audio seconds from video.

The 9B `klein-large` model was added for text-to-image generation and reference-image editing. Flux also gained a 1024×1024 total-pixel cap, clearer dimension validation, and HTTP errors instead of server crashes on unexpected generation failures.

`gemini-legacy` was added with a 1M-token context window and support for text, image, audio, and video inputs. It returns text and supports reasoning, tools, search, and code execution.

highlights.title: Turn images into video
highlights.text: Use `wan` to turn an image into a 720p video lasting 2–15 seconds. Auto-dubbed audio is on by default; set `audio=false` to skip it. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=wan).

highlights.title: Klein gets a 9B variant
highlights.text: Generate images or edit them with reference images using `klein-large`. The 9B model has a non-commercial license. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=klein-large).

highlights.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro added
highlights.text: Use `gemini-legacy` for a 1M-token context window, multimodal inputs, reasoning, tools, search, and code execution. It returns text. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-legacy).
